steps.question: What does the evidence below show about the electrochemical property and how the material performs in service?
observations: CnC HS holds roughly 93-100% Coulombic efficiency to about 205 cycles; C HS data end near 50 cycles after falling to zero at ~40 and ~48
C HS voltage spikes grow from ~2600 min and its trace ends near 4400 min at the 'C HS battery failure' arrow, while CnC HS stays within ~0.03 V to 7100 min
The two hosts' plating plateaus nearly coincide at the lowest rate and separate strongly at the highest (about -0.05 V vs -0.10 V)
Nucleation overpotentials of 39 mV and 43 mV are marked on the two initial discharge profiles
Under a stepped current-density staircase C HS develops large voltage spikes from ~2300 min while CnC HS stays within ~0.05 V to 3500 min
